scalars.scalar_value: One (1) to two (2) years of experience in logistics, warehousing, mail services, or a related field

items.item_text: One (1) to two (2) years of experience in logistics, warehousing, mail services, or a related field
Experience with Google Workspace strongly preferred

Mail Processing — Receive, sort, weigh, scan, track, and distribute incoming, outgoing, and interoffice mail accurately and within established timeframes. Process member, provider, regulatory, and operational correspondence in accordance with departmental procedures.

Managed Care Operations Support — Receive, date-stamp, track, and route time-sensitive documents, including utilization management requests, appeals and grievances, regulatory correspondence, and other operational communications requiring timely processing and distribution.

Package Handling — Receive shipments from carriers and couriers, verify deliveries against packing documentation, maintain receipt records, and coordinate delivery to appropriate departments and business locations.

Mail Systems Operations — Operate and maintain automated mailing equipment, postage management systems, scanning technology, document processing tools, and associated tracking systems. Coordinate maintenance activities, troubleshooting, and vendor support as needed to ensure continuity of operations.

Document Tracking and Records Management — Maintain accurate tracking logs and records for accountable mail, certified mail, regulatory correspondence, and other documents requiring audit trails or documentation. Support reporting and record retention activities as required.
Inventory Management — Monitor and maintain postage supplies, shipping materials, mailroom inventory, and operational resources necessary to support daily mail processing activities.
Attention to detail and accuracy in sorting, scanning, and recordkeeping, including logs of accountable mail
Ability to operate mailroom equipment, including postage meters, sorting machines, and scanners
Knowledge of safe material-handling and lifting practices
Ability to maintain the confidentiality of medical records and protected health information
Good organizational, time-management, and customer-service skills
Strong technical skills and high comfort level with a variety of software preferred
